tools.name: net_worth_percentile
tools.description: Given a household net worth in USD and a country (and optionally the age of the household head), return the wealth percentile it falls in and the 'top X%'. Answers questions like 'what percentile is a $500k net worth in Germany', 'is $1M a lot in Japan' or 'is $200k good at 30 in the US'. Public agg

tools.name: country_net_worth_thresholds
tools.description: Return the household net worth (USD) needed to reach the median and the top 25%, 10%, 5%, and 1% in a given country. Use for 'what net worth is top 1% in the UK' or to build a wealth-distribution table. Public data.

tools.name: net_worth_by_age
tools.description: Household net worth by age of the household head in a country: the median and the top 10% and top 1% cutoffs for each age group (under 35, 35 to 44 … 75 or older). tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: List every country KeepUp has wealth-distribution data for, with whether it has full survey breakpoints (higher precision at the tails). Call this to discover valid country codes.
